validation.method: repeated stratified shuffled random five-fold cross-validation

representations.docking_only: Arithmetic mean of available best-pose Glide scores across RRCS-selected active- and inactive-state conformations (1D)
representations.dynamic_glep: Dimension-wise mean and population standard deviation of EquiScore embeddings across RRCS-selected conformations (256D)

external51.role: prospective exploratory candidate prioritization; not an independent labeled performance test set
external51.interpretation: positive score indicates relative alpha1A tendency; no alpha1B-versus-alpha1D assignment
